declarations.description:
Hash of the input mapping's device name, retained on disconnect.
Identical names have the same hash; use the gamepad index to distinguish devices.
The value can be retained; reverse lookup of the name is not guaranteed.

declarations.description:
Iterates the latest completed binding update, with text actions last.
The iterator starts before the first action. Multiple iterators advance
independently. The next binding update invalidates existing iterators and
current actions.
